lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਨਗਨ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਨਂੀਦ ਨ ਸੋਵਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik nagan phirahi din raat na(n)eed na sovahee ||
lines.translation: Some wander naked day and night and never sleep.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲਾਵਹਿ ਅੰਗੁ ਆਪੁ ਵਿਗੋਵਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik agan jalaavahi a(n)g aap vigovahee ||
lines.translation: Some burn their limbs in fire, damaging and ruining themselves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਤਨੁ ਛਾਰੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਿ ਰੋਵਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: vin naavai tan chhaar kiaa kahi rovahee ||
lines.translation: Without the Name, the body is reduced to ashes; what good is it to speak and cry then?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਹਨਿ ਖਸਮ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹੀ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: sohan khasam duaar j satigur sevahee ||15||
lines.translation: Those who serve the True Guru, are embellished and exalted in the Court of their Lord and Master. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲੈ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਦਰਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabeehaa a(n)mrit velai boliaa taa(n) dar sunee pukaar ||
lines.translation: The rainbird chirps in the ambrosial hours of the morning before the dawn; its prayers are heard in the Court of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਘੈ ਨੋ ਫੁਰਮਾਨੁ ਹੋਆ ਵਰਸਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: meghai no phuramaan hoaa varasahu kirapaa dhaar ||
lines.translation: The order is issued to the clouds, to let the rains of mercy shower down.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau tin kai balihaaranai jinee sach rakhiaa ur dhaar ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who enshrine the True Lord within their hearts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਭ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naame sabh hareeaavalee gur kai sabad veechaar ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, through the Name, all are rejuvenated, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਇਵ ਤੇਰੀ ਤਿਖਾ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabeehaa iv teree tikhaa na utarai je sau karahi pukaar ||
lines.translation: O rainbird, this is not the way to quench your thirst, even though you may cry out a hundred times.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਦਰੀ ਉਪਜੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: nadaree satigur paaeeai nadaree upajai piaar ||
lines.translation: By God's Grace, the True Guru is found; by His Grace, love wells up.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saahib man vasai vichahu jaahi vikaar ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, when the Lord and Master abides in the mind, corruption and evil leave from within. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਜੈਨੀ ਉਝੜ ਪਾਇ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਖੁਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik jainee ujhaR paai dhurahu khuaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Some are Jains, wasting their time in the wilderness; by their pre-ordained destiny, they are ruined.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨੑਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin mukh naahee naam na teerath nhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is not on their lips; they do not bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਥੀ ਸਿਰ ਖੋਹਾਇ ਨ ਭਦੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hathee sir khohaai na bhad karaaiaa ||
lines.translation: They pull out their hair with their hands, instead of shaving.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੁਚਿਲ ਰਹਹਿ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kuchil rahahi din raat sabad na bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: They remain unclean day and night; they do not love the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਪਤਿ ਨ ਕਰਮੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin jaat na pat na karam janam gavaaiaa ||
lines.translation: They have no status, no honor, and no good karma. They waste away their lives in vain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਜੂਠੈ ਵੇਜਾਤਿ ਜੂਠਾ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: man joothai vejaat joothaa khaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Their minds are false and impure; that which they eat is impure and defiled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਆਚਾਰੁ ਨ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin sabadai aachaar na kin hee paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Without the Shabad, no one achieves a lifestyle of good conduct.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh oa(n)kaar sach samaaiaa ||16||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh is absorbed in the True Lord God, the Universal Creator. ||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਵਣਿ ਸਰਸੀ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: saavan sarasee kaamanee gurasabadee veechaar ||
lines.translation: In the month of Saawan, the bride is happy, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sadaa suhaaganee gur kai het apaar ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, she is a happy soul-bride forever; her love for the Guru is unlimited. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਵਣਿ ਦਝੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: saavan dajhai gun baaharee jis doojai bhaai piaar ||
lines.translation: In Saawan, she who has no virtue is burned, in attachment and love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਸਭੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak pir kee saar na jaanaee sabh seegaar khuaar ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, she does not appreciate the value of her Husband Lord; all her decorations are worthless. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਉ ਹਠਿ ਨ ਪਤੀਜਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa alakh abheu hath na pateejaee ||
lines.translation: The True, Unseen, Mysterious Lord is not won over by stubbornness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰਾਗ ਪਰੀਆ ਰਾਗਿ ਨ ਭੀਜਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik gaavahi raag pareeaa raag na bheejaee ||
lines.translation: Some sing according to traditional ragas, but the Lord is not pleased by these ragas.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਨਚਿ ਨਚਿ ਪੂਰਹਿ ਤਾਲ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਕੀਜਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik nach nach poorahi taal bhagat na keejaee ||
lines.translation: Some dance and dance and keep the beat, but they do not worship Him with devotion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਅੰਨੁ ਨ ਖਾਹਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik a(n)n na khaahi moorakh tinaa kiaa keejaee ||
lines.translation: Some refuse to eat; what can be done with these fools?

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਹੋਈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਿਵੈ ਨ ਧੀਜਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: trisanaa hoee bahut kivai na dheejaee ||
lines.translation: Thirst and desire have greatly increased; nothing brings satisfaction.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਵਧਹਿ ਕੈ ਲੋਅ ਖਪਿ ਮਰੀਜਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: karam vadhahi kai lo khap mareejaee ||
lines.translation: Some are tied down by rituals; they hassle themselves to death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: laahaa naam sa(n)saar a(n)mrit peejaee ||
lines.translation: In this world, profit comes by drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਅਸਨੇਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਘੀਜਈ ॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: har bhagatee asanehi guramukh gheejaee ||17||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs gather in loving devotional worship of the Lord. ||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਲਾਰ ਰਾਗੁ ਜੋ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh malaar raag jo karahi tin man tan seetal hoi ||
lines.translation: Those Gurmukhs who sing in the Raga of Malaar - their minds and bodies become cool and calm.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਏਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurasabadee ek pachhaaniaa eko sachaa soi ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they realize the One, the One True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan sachaa sach man sache sachee soi ||
lines.translation: Their minds and bodies are true; they obey the True Lord, and they are known as true.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dar sachee bhagat hai sahaje hee pat hoi ||
lines.translation: True devotional worship is deep within them; they are automatically blessed with honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਰਾਹੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kalijug mahi ghor a(n)dhaar hai manamukh raahu na koi ||
lines.translation: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, there is utter darkness; the self-willed manmukh cannot find the way.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: se vadabhaagee naanakaa jin guramukh paragat hoi ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, very blessed are those Gurmukhs, unto whom the Lord is revealed. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇੰਦੁ ਵਰਸੈ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਮਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਚਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: i(n)d varasai kar daiaa lokaa(n) man upajai chaau ||
lines.translation: The clouds rain down mercifully, and joy wells up in the minds of the people.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਇੰਦੁ ਵਰਸਦਾ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਂਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis kai hukam i(n)d varasadaa tis kai sad balihaarai jaa(n)u ||
lines.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to the One, by whose Command the clouds burst forth with rain.
